prompts.lv2:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: Gautama spaceship mutation concept sprite for Starsector.
Input image 1 is the ORIGINAL Gautama edit target and the mandatory geometry reference.
Preserve the original full image framing, orientation (bow up), aspect ratio, normalized canvas570×555, pivot(285,277.5), major exterior contour, silhouette proportions, exact positions and sizes of the original main hull lobes, large mounting recesses and FOUR existing engine outlets. The original silhouette and engine/collision layout must still fit the edited sprite. Do not recenter, zoom, stretch, rotate, add wings or new limbs, broaden the ship, extend its height, or create a new shape. Keep transparent space and original empty cavities where they establish its silhouette. Do NOT bake any size increase into this art; every stage uses the SAME base layout and will be scaled later in the game.
The existing design has a chunky left ivory shoulder, tall central keel, irregular open machinery on the right, and a lower central skull-like industrial assembly; preserve these distinctive parts in their original locations.
Change the INTERNAL armor/plating and machinery to express mutation of a living self-assembling machine, not ordinary damage/weathering alone. Match native top-down painted 2D Starsector sprite rendering: small controlled mechanical detail, matte ivory and weathered gray-green metal, very dark recessed ribs and cable bundles. Mechanical and bone-like, not biological flesh or insect chitin. No photorealistic3D render, glossy chrome, bright new colors, neon, flame plumes, background, labels or text. One complete ship, genuinely transparent background, nothing clipped.
Mutation level2: mildly but visibly warped and overgrown. Within the locked silhouette, thicken a few original armor seams into uneven overlapping pale ridges, add local knotted cables and irregular mechanical growth around existing recesses, and deform some internal rib spacing. About15–20% of surface geometry visibly changes. Retain most clean original plates so this reads as the early stage. Do not simply redraw or upscale the unchanged reference.
